     def _print_sign(self, func):
         return '((({0}) > 0) - (({0}) < 0))'.format(self._print(func.args[0]))
 
+    def _print_Relational(self, expr):
+        """Print a Relational expression (e.g., Ne, Eq, Lt, etc.) in C code format."""
+        lhs = self._print(expr.lhs)
+        rhs = self._print(expr.rhs)
+        rel_op = expr.rel_op
+        
+        # Map SymPy relational operators to C operators
+        op_map = {
+            '==': '==',
+            '!=': '!=',
+            '<': '<',
+            '<=': '<=',
+            '>': '>',
+            '>=': '>=',
+        }
+        
+        if rel_op in op_map:
+            return '{0} {1} {2}'.format(lhs, op_map[rel_op], rhs)
+        else:
+            # Fallback for unknown operators
+            return '{0} {1} {2}'.format(lhs, rel_op, rhs)
+
+    def _print_sinc(self, expr):
+        """Print sinc function as a piecewise expression."""
+        from sympy import Piecewise, Ne, sin
+        arg = expr.args[0]
+        # sinc(x) = sin(x)/x for x != 0, and 1 for x = 0
+        piecewise_expr = Piecewise(
+            (sin(arg)/arg, Ne(arg, 0)),
+            (1, True)
+        )
+        return self._print(piecewise_expr)
+
